how_it_works.title: From CV to tailored application in 3 steps.
how_it_works.subtitle: No templates. No copy-paste. Just drop your CV and let our AI agents do the heavy lifting.

steps.title: Upload Your CV
steps.desc: Drop your resume once. Ariadne extracts your skills, experience, and career goals to build a semantic profile that gets smarter over time.

steps.title: Paste a Job Link — or Let Us Find One
steps.desc: Provide a job posting URL, or activate Explore Mode. Our Scout Agent browses the web and surfaces the roles that actually match your profile.

steps.title: Review, Approve & Apply
steps.desc: Our Writer Agent drafts a hyper-personalized cover letter. A Critic Agent audits it. You review, tweak if needed, and send — all in under 5 minutes.

features.title: Every application, engineered for impact.
features.subtitle: Most AI tools paste generic text. Ariadne deploys specialized agents that analyze, write, and critique — so every letter lands.

gap.title: 94% Match Accuracy
gap.desc: Semantic analysis compares your CV against the job description at a conceptual level — not keywords. You get a precise fit score and a clear list of gaps to address.

tone.title: Sounds Like You, Not AI
tone.desc: The Writer Agent learns your personal tone from every review. After 2 applications, it writes exactly like you — but sharper, tighter, and more compelling.

zap.title: You Stay in Control
zap.desc: No black-box magic. Every draft goes through your review before anything is finalized. Edit, rewrite, or approve — the final word is always yours.

scout.title: No job link? No problem.
scout.subtitle: Activate Explore Mode and let Ariadne's Scout Agent search the web for roles that match your profile. You focus on interviews — we handle the hunting.

items.quote: I used to spend 2 hours per application. Now it takes me 5 minutes to review and approve. I landed 3 interviews in my first week.
items.author: Elena R.

items.a: Yes. You can generate applications for free with no credit card required. We offer premium tiers for high-volume users and advanced features.

items.q: Does it work for any industry?
items.a: Absolutely. Ariadne's semantic matching works across tech, finance, healthcare, consulting, creative roles, and more. It analyzes skills and context — not industry-specific templates.

items.q: Will the cover letters sound generic?
items.a: No. Our Writer Agent learns your personal tone from your feedback. After 2-3 reviews, it adapts to your voice — resulting in letters that sound like you, but better.
Your CV and personal data are encrypted and never shared with third parties. We use enterprise-grade security with Supabase authentication and row-level access policies.

items.q: Can I edit the generated letters?
items.a: Of course. You have full control. Every draft goes through your review — you can edit, request a rewrite, or approve before anything is finalized.
